data.rationale: The proposal matches the true Kayak hotel-search procedure (open hotels, type destination and pick suggestion, choose dates, set rooms/guests via Increment, Search/Update, then filter and sort), but it hard-codes the sort to price low to high and splits the parameters more finely than the true ones; the filters are vaguer than the true "Distance" filter. A browser automation could still be built from it.
